name: @margoengine/webgl2-compat
description: The WebGL2 compatibility layer for browsers without WebGPU (milestones M0 to M8 done); the site's demos run on it there. install() gives core a WebGPU-shaped device on WebGL2 that translates WGSL to GLSL ES 3.00; render shaders, texture views, readbacks of every copyable format, occlusion queries, render bundles, external textures, gather and storage-buffer reads run, compute pipelines run as fragment draws, point draws or on the CPU, whichever the shader allows, and DOF, splats and culling take routes of their own there. The voxel path tracer and XR refuse it.
author: Scott Campbell
